_comment: Brand-asset manifest for learn.nulltag.ch. Same contract as the one in
music-site: each entry names a source on the open web and the file it
should become here, at the size this site actually uses.

void #0a0a0a, bone #e8e3da, tiefrot #ff2a55 — so the learning site and
the music site read as the same label.
